{{Top|leg}}
A '''luma flare''' was a rocket-launched [[Flare/Legends|flare]] that spread illumination over a large area when detonated. They were a self-contained mechanism; the operator set a horizontal and vertical distance for detonation and when fired, the flare was propelled to the detonation point. Luma flares could be used to mark [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] strikes, and to alert rescue ships to the presence of downed [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]]. [[Salamini Chemical Munitions]] produced the [[Model-3287]] luma flare during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
